You will be informed up front as to how much the case fee is and how long your time commitment will be, usually between 20-50 minutes.

steps: Register free at jurytest.net to join the eligible juror pool
Opt into case notifications (as often as once a week)
Receive an 'e-juror summons' email from jurycommissioner@jurytest.net when a case opens in your area
Log in, stream the case presentation, and answer the questionnaire
Submit; pay is disclosed upfront so you can accept or decline before starting
Get paid by PayPal or check within 7 business days (sometimes 2)
timing: Checks and online payments processed within 7 business days after the case (sometimes within 2 business days). PayPal or check.
who_pays: JuryTest Networks pays you directly — the money comes from the attorneys who hire JuryTest to test their cases, and JuryTest sends it to you by PayPal or check.
who_qualifies: Registered juror-pool members, with cases matched to your geographic area; one account per IP address. The official FAQ states no age, voter-registration, or other eligibility rule beyond the pool signup — but you must be where attorneys are posting cases.
work_available: Scarce and irregular. The official FAQ warns you may not be called for weeks at a time in the early months, and case invitations depend entirely on attorneys in your area. This is occasional side income — sign up on several mock-jury sites, because JuryTest alone will not give you steady work.
what_gets_accepted: A case counts when you log in, stream the full case presentation, and submit the follow-up questionnaire. One account per IP address is strictly enforced — signing up under multiple emails to get paid twice on a case is prohibited.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Registration is free — no fee of any kind. Your unpaid time is the waiting between cases (weeks possible) plus the minutes spent reading e-juror summons emails. Each case's fee and time commitment (usually 20-50 minutes) are disclosed upfront, so you can decline low-fee cases before spending any time.
when_cash_arrives: By PayPal or check. Per the official FAQ: checks and online payments are processed within 7 business days after the case, and in some cases within two business days.
